headline_of_the_week: Series C is broken across Europe (85 percent of the 2021-2023 Series B cohort has NOT raised C) and US female-founded VC share has halved in one year to 1.1 percent, while Aleph closes Fund V at $150M for Israel and Women TechEU shifts to weekly Tuesday cutoffs.

headlines.title: Silverpeak H1 2026: 85 percent of European 2021-2023 Series B cohort has NOT raised Series C
headlines.summary: 486 of 575 European Series B companies from 2021-2023 are stuck without a Series C. 18.5B EUR of committed capital is stalled. Top five H1 2026 Series B+C deals took 55 percent of all follow-on capital, cementing concentration as the structural feature of the ladder.

headlines.title: HerForward: US female-founded VC share halved in one year, 2.1 percent to 1.1 percent
headlines.summary: HerForward's US tracker shows female-founded share of VC dollars dropped from 2.1 percent in 2024 to 1.1 percent in 2025. Anthropic's 2025 concentration hid the collapse for every other female founder.

headlines.title: W Group tracker: $1.55B raised in global women's health equity in 2025 across 85 companies
headlines.summary: W Group's 2026 tracker documents 85 women's health equity rounds worth $1.55B in 2025, the highest annual total on record. Sector-specific investor interest is compounding as generalist capital pulls back.

headlines.title: Aleph Fund V closes at $150M for Israeli early-stage
headlines.summary: Aleph closed Fund V at $150M this week for Israeli early-stage. Fresh capital reaches the market inside four weeks of the IIA NIS 1B fast-track opening, giving Israeli founders a rare simultaneous non-dilutive plus dilutive window.

headlines.title: Scribe Therapeutics prices $128.7M upsized IPO, Jennifer Doudna co-founded
headlines.summary: First 2026 gene-editing IPO co-founded by a woman. 7,575,000 shares priced. A live public-market data point for gender-lens returns as the CRISPR sector reopens for public capital.

headlines.title: Israeli startups raised $1.5B in July 2026
headlines.summary: Globes reports Israeli startups raised roughly $1.5B in July, extending the July momentum from the Aleph Fund V close and the IIA shekel fast-track.

headlines.title: Aurenar closes $5.7M oversubscribed seed for AI drug discovery
headlines.summary: Female co-founded biotech Aurenar closed an oversubscribed $5.7M seed round for AI drug discovery. Adds a fresh European biotech data point to the women's health and biotech capital story.

headlines.title: European Prize for Women Innovators 2026 awards EUR 100K to Katerina Spranger of Oxford Heartbeat
headlines.summary: Chat EIC analysis of the 2026 European Prize for Women Innovators highlights Katerina Spranger, founder of Oxford Heartbeat, as the EUR 100K awardee. Signals continued EU non-dilutive commitment to deep-tech female founders.

headlines.title: Women TechEU 3rd edition shifts to weekly Tuesday cutoffs, next Aug 11
headlines.summary: The 3rd edition eligibility-check strand runs every Tuesday at 17:00 CET. Aug 4 has now passed, so the next window is Aug 11. InfoDay Sep 15. EUR 75K plus coaching for 160 startups across 2026-2028.

headlines.title: tech.eu H1 2026: EUR 44.1B European tech investment across roughly 1,740 deals
headlines.summary: tech.eu's H1 2026 report clocks EUR 44.1B invested across around 1,740 deals in European tech, confirming the concentration story documented by Silverpeak.

headlines.title: US Vermilion Cliffs Fund II update, solo GP Ashley Smith deploying $25M
headlines.summary: Solo GP Ashley Smith's Vermilion Cliffs Fund II is now actively deploying its $25M pool, adding to the small but growing set of female GPs writing checks in the current cycle.

headlines.title: Anthropic hits $170B private valuation on secondary trades
headlines.summary: Secondary market prices Anthropic at $170B, reinforcing 2025-2026 female-founder capital concentration into one AI outlier and making every other data point look worse when Anthropic is excluded.
